messages:
kira: Starting staged rollout v2.14.0 -> 10% in eu-west during quiet window (20:00-21:00). Release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/2.14.0 — includes kvcache fix and batching opt.
deploybot: [automated] initiating traffic shift: service=inference region=eu-west from=stable to=v2.14.0 percent=10
sam: noted. monitoring dashboards up. will watch auth & edge 5xx.
mike: quick heads-up — saw a small auth spike on edge-a just after warmup (~+2%). could be retries. keep an eye.
olivia: Oncall here. if we see >3% 5xx sustained for 5m we should pause. flagging now.
deploybot: [automated] traffic shift progress: 3/10 nodes shifted. ETA ~2m.
kira: pinging infra for any infra changes that might affect cookie routing @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: pinging infra-oncall-team: please confirm no config drifts in edge routing for eu-west.
sam: digging into logs — found repeated 502s from upstream pool pool-eu-a with trace id abc123..abc127. sample logs:
```
2026-03-21T20:05:12Z edge-a connection error -> 502 upstream reset trace=abc123
2026-03-21T20:05:18Z edge-b 200 ok trace=abc124
```
mike: that pattern suggests a backend transient. if it spikes to 4% we'll want to stop the rollout.
kira: let's put a manual hold until we confirm. pausing now.
deploybot: [automated] rollout paused by kira — current percent=10. reason="manual pause requested". To resume: `/deploy resume 1771234560`.
sam: I forwarded traces to backend owners. they're investigating pool-eu-a (suspect connection pooling regression from config flag). will update in 2m.
mike: +1 to inspect before further ramp. can we also pin traffic for the affected nodes to v2.13.9 while we investigate?
kira: vote: pause + inspect :thumbsup:
olivia: formal stopvote: :thumbsup: — halting ramp until backend confirms.
oncall-bot: escalation: paging infra-oncall (pager duty) — incident created IR-2026-031
sam: backend owners rolled a quick patch to connection pool config on pool-eu-a. rerunning healthchecks now.
sam: healthchecks show error rate down to baseline ~0.3% over 3m.
mike: nice. I still want a safety net — recommend we rollback the 10% hosts in edge-a to v2.13.9 and keep remainder pinned until we prebake again.
kira: agree. do the minimal revert on affected hosts.
sam: running revert command:
```
/deploy revert --service=inference --region=eu-west --hosts=edge-a --to=v2.13.9 --reason="mitigate upstream 502s"
```
deploybot: [automated] revert queued: target hosts=edge-a. estimated time 3m.
deploybot: [automated] revert completed: edge-a -> v2.13.9. Verified traffic back to baseline. latency stable. metrics snapshot: 5xx went from 2.2% -> 0.35% in 4m.
kira: good call. I'll update release notes with the postmortem and add the config caveat. also adjusting canary policy to require 10m stable at each step for next rollouts.
olivia: please add a short ops PSA: team should not proceed with >20% ramp without infra signoff for pool changes.
oncall-bot: note: IR-2026-031 resolved and linked to release 2.14.0.
mike: can we also pin the rollout so it doesn't auto-expand? set rollout.auto=false
sam: set `rollout.auto=false` for this deployment in the control plane. confirm: done.
kira: closing the stop/go thread — thanks everyone. will re-run prebake tomorrow morning after a deeper test. Action items: update release notes, add canary timeout + infra signoff, follow-up postmortem.
olivia: thanks — filing release-note update task and marking change window note.
